decision_question: Can bounded write-demand/interference geometry provide a better mitosis boundary than semantic address identity, and can the resulting functional identity be recovered from inference-visible frozen representations?

data.identity: same pinned model/dataset revisions and SHA-256 manifest mechanism as Core 006

router.global_router: exact Core 006 frozen K-means address router

cells.form: delta_h = U A z, z=U^T h, U fixed orthonormal; only A mutable

functional_modes.identity_signal: foundation-path write demand G=mean_t[(U^T dL/dh_t) z_t^T]
functional_modes.activation_geometry: 99%-energy principal-subspace overlap of per-mode z covariance
functional_modes.write_geometry: principal-subspace overlap of bounded vec(G) write bases
functional_modes.interference_geometry: symmetric normalized tr(D_i Sigma_j D_i^T), where D_i is mean write matrix
functional_modes.partition: deterministic balanced max-cut heuristic; semantic_singleton isolates the triggering address/mode as Core 006 control

routing.oracle: functional mode inferred from foundation-path write demand; diagnostic/upper-bound only
routing.deployable: z-only cosine prototype router within the frozen global address
routing.soft_top2: evaluation-only diagnostic over the two closest z prototypes; not used to select the scientific winner

operation: partition currently owned functional modes using frozen winner boundary
move one partition of modes to child
recompute parent/child certificates from bounded mode covariances
split is function preserving under oracle mode identity because child A equals parent A

baselines.source: Core 006 run_seed executed on the same confirmation seed/data

discovery.selection_rule: aggregate the two discovery seeds; choose exactly one boundary candidate by maximum frozen weighted score, lexical candidate name as deterministic tie-break

interpretation_boundary: Discovery seeds may select the boundary mechanism but cannot emit a scientific supported/not-supported decision.
The confirmation winner must be locked before 80711/80712/80713 are opened.
Oracle functional routing uses labels/gradients and is not deployable; confirmation additionally gates z-only routing identifiability.
A positive result remains limited to frozen Pythia representations, frozen global addresses, linear writable Cells, and bounded functional-mode state.
Core 006 thresholds/results are frozen and are not retuned or overwritten by this experiment.
